label: Early original-phase input of o/w/0/a/i
explanation: Fires mainly while the original sequence is being read (about 90% of activation mass), concentrated on the first four positions (t=0-3 hold about 85% of mass; rate falls off sharply after t=3). Within those positions it is driven by the input token: o, w, 0, a and i have rates of 16-22% vs a 5% base rate and together carry about 70% of mass. The strongest activations are o/w/0/a at t=2-3 after an early u or b prefix (e.g. b u w 0, u u o). The activation often persists one step after a trigger token, so the next input is frequently weakly active. Rarely fires at the delimiter or during the copy phase (rate 1-4%, mostly weak, a little higher at the last copy steps of long sequences). The token alone is not sufficient: many o/w/0/a/i inputs at t<=3 stay inactive depending on the preceding tokens, and other tokens (t, g, c, u) give weaker activations. Best simple predicate dev F1 about 0.55, mass recall 0.66.
